description: Set attention weights of the running sessions at once, e.g. {"abc": 0.7, "def": 0.3}. Applies to the whole session, or with from_now only from now on (the user switched what they attend to; the time before keeps its split). For a finished session use edit_session.

from_now.description: true: the new split holds from now on, the earlier time keeps its split

name: split_attention
title: Split attention
